scripts.//: Two products, one codebase. `VoiceDumps-qwee` is the full internal build (Slack, Discord, calendar, Bedrock); `VoiceDumps` is the public one, which drops the `assistant` Cargo feature and keeps transcription, dictation, recording, history and the reading UI — nothing to configure, nothing to sign in to. Names differ, identifiers are load-bearing: macOS keys each app's data directory off `identifier`, so changing `ai.qwee.voicedumps` or `dev.heynaavi.voicedump` orphans an existing install's database, ledger and knowledge store. Rename the product freely; never the identifier. (tauri.conf.json rejects unknown keys, so this note cannot live next to them.)
